definitions.text_mt: Nar jew ċumnija, speċjalment dik tal-kċina fejn isir it-tisjir

usage_examples.mt: Poġġejt il-ħatab fil-foklar biex nagħmel in-nar.
usage_examples.en: I put the firewood in the hearth to make a fire.

usage_examples.mt: Il-foklar antik kien imżeijen bil-ġebel artiġjanali.
usage_examples.en: The old hearth was decorated with hand-carved stone.

definitions.text_mt: Paġna ta' ktieb jew dokument miktub jew stampat
Biċċa rqiqa ta' metall, karta, ħġieġ jew materjal ieħor

usage_examples.mt: Qaleb il-folja bil-mod biex ma jqattagħhiex.
usage_examples.en: He turned the page slowly so as not to tear it.

usage_examples.mt: Il-folja tal-landa kienet irqiqa wisq għas-saqaf.
usage_examples.en: The tin sheet was too thin for the roof.

definitions.text_mt: Weraq dens ta' siġar u pjanti, weraq kbir

usage_examples.mt: Il-foljam tas-siġar ħoloq dell frisk fil-ġnien.
usage_examples.en: The foliage of the trees created cool shade in the garden.

usage_examples.mt: Waqgħa l-foljam mill-ġewż kollu wara l-maltemp.
usage_examples.en: All the walnut foliage fell off after the storm.

definitions.text_mt: Ġabra kbira ta' nies f'post wieħed

usage_examples.mt: Il-folla fil-pjazza kienet tistenna l-bidu tal-festa.
usage_examples.en: The crowd in the square was waiting for the start of the feast.

usage_examples.mt: Folla kbira nġabret quddiem il-monument.
usage_examples.en: A large crowd gathered in front of the monument.

usage_examples.mt: Ma stajtx nara xejn minħabba l-folla.
usage_examples.en: I could not see anything because of the crowd.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ftuħ fil-wiċċ tal-bniedem u l-annimali li bih jieklu u jitkellmu
Fetħa jew toqba ta' xi ħaġa, bħal ta' flixkun jew għar

usage_examples.mt: Fetħet fommha biex tgħid xi ħaġa imma ma ħarġet l-ebda kelma.
usage_examples.en: She opened her mouth to say something but no word came out.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħalib ħareġ minn fomm il-flixkun malajr wisq.
usage_examples.en: The milk came out of the mouth of the bottle too quickly.

definitions.text_mt: Il-post fejn xmara tiltaqa' mal-baħar

usage_examples.mt: Il-belt inbniet eżattament fejn hemm fomm ix-xmara.
usage_examples.en: The city was built right where the rivermouth is.

usage_examples.mt: Id-dgħajjes iż-żgħar ħarġu minn fomm ix-xmara lejn il-baħar miftuħ.
usage_examples.en: The small boats went out from the rivermouth towards the open sea.

entry.source_citation: Wiktionary: fomm tax-xmara (Alternative spelling of fomm ix-xmara)

definitions.text_mt: Il-post fejn xmara tiltaqa' mal-baħar (ortografija alternattiva ta' 'fomm ix-xmara')

usage_examples.mt: Saħbna joqgħod ħdejn fomm tax-xmara.
usage_examples.en: Our friend lives near the rivermouth.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu distanza kbira 'l isfel mill-wiċċ sal-qiegħ

usage_examples.mt: Il-bir huwa fond wisq biex naraw il-qiegħ.
usage_examples.en: The well is too deep for us to see the bottom.

usage_examples.mt: L-għerien fondi ta' dawn l-għoljiet huma famużi.
usage_examples.en: The deep caves of these hills are famous.

definitions.text_en: depth (that which is deep below the deepest part)
definitions.text_mt: Fond jew qiegħ ta' xi ħaġa (bħall-baħar jew bir)
Bażi ta' xi ħaġa, parti li ssostni
Parti l-aktar baxxa jew ta' taħt ta' xi ħaġa
Ġabra ta' flus għal skop partikolari

usage_examples.mt: Il-fond tal-baħar f'dan il-post huwa ta' mitejn metru.
usage_examples.en: The depth of the sea in this place is two hundred metres.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bużżiegħa niżlet sal-qiegħ tal-baħar.
usage_examples.en: The diver descended to the bottom of the sea.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk jogħġbok dona flus biex tgħin lill-fond tal-iskejjel.
usage_examples.en: Please donate money to help the school fund.

definitions.text_mt: Lukanda żgħira jew post fejn jorqdu u jieklu l-vjaġġaturi

usage_examples.mt: Sibna post fil-fondoq għal-lejla wara l-vjaġġ twil.
usage_examples.en: We found a place at the inn for the night after the long journey.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fondoq kien mimli vjaġġaturi mis-Sqallija.
usage_examples.en: The inn was full of travellers from Sicily.

definitions.text_mt: Il-fergħa tal-lingwistika li tistudja l-ħsejjes u s-sistema tal-ħoss tal-lingwi

usage_examples.mt: Il-fonoloġija tal-Malti tinkludi l-ittra għajn li ma tinstabx f'ħafna lingwi oħra.
usage_examples.en: The phonology of Maltese includes the letter għajn which is not found in many other languages.

usage_examples.mt: L-istudent qiegħed jistudja l-fonoloġija bħala parti mill-kors tal-lingwistika.
usage_examples.en: The student is studying phonology as part of the linguistics course.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-fonoloġija jew mal-ħsejjes tal-lingwa

usage_examples.mt: L-analiżi fonoloġika tal-Malti turi sistema kumplessa ta' konsonanti.
usage_examples.en: The phonological analysis of Maltese shows a complex system of consonants.

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xogħol fonoloġiku ta' dan il-lingwista huwa magħruf madwar id-dinja.
usage_examples.en: The phonological work of this linguist is known around the world.

definitions.text_en: Fontana (a village and local council of the Gozo Region, Malta)
definitions.text_mt: Raħal u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun ta' Għawdex, Malta

usage_examples.mt: Fontana hija waħda mill-iżgħar irħula f'Għawdex.
usage_examples.en: Fontana is one of the smallest villages in Gozo.

usage_examples.mt: Il-festa ta' Fontana tiġi ċċelebrata f'Lulju ta' kull sena.
usage_examples.en: The feast of Fontana is celebrated in July every year.

definitions.text_mt: Art kbira miksija b'siġar u veġetazzjoni selvaġġa

usage_examples.mt: Imxejna fil-foresta għal sigħat mingħajr ma ltqajna ma' ħadd.
usage_examples.en: We walked in the forest for hours without meeting anyone.

usage_examples.mt: Il-foresta kienet mimlija b'għasafar ta' kull xorta.
usage_examples.en: The forest was full of birds of all kinds.

definitions.text_mt: Struttura tal-injam għall-ġustizzja tal-mewt permezz ta' ħabel

usage_examples.mt: Il-kriminal ġie kkundannat għall-mewt bil-forka.
usage_examples.en: The criminal was sentenced to death by the gallows.

usage_examples.mt: Il-forka kienet tintuża fi żminijiet imgħoddija bħala forma ta' kastig.
usage_examples.en: The gallows was used in times past as a form of punishment.

etymology_chain.definition: would have become forma in older Maltese

definitions.text_mt: Għamla jew dehra ta' xi ħaġa
Għodda li tagħti l-għamla lil materjal

usage_examples.mt: Il-forma tal-mejda kienet tonda, mhux kwadra.
usage_examples.en: The shape of the table was round, not square.

usage_examples.mt: Ħadt il-forma mit-tafal biex nagħmel il-platti.
usage_examples.en: I took the mould from the clay to make the plates.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kejk ħareġ perfett mill-forma l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: The cake came out perfectly from the new mould.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess tal-bini, il-ħolqien jew it-twaqqif ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Il-formazzjoni tal-gżira bdiet eluf ta' snin ilu.
usage_examples.en: The formation of the island began thousands of years ago.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġeologu spjega l-formazzjoni tal-blat f'dan ir-reġjun.
usage_examples.en: The geologist explained the formation of the rock in this region.

definitions.text_mt: Kunjom Malti

usage_examples.mt: Is-Sur Formosa għallem lill-ġenerazzjonijiet kollha tar-raħal.
usage_examples.en: Mr Formosa taught all the generations of the village.

definitions.text_mt: Apparat jew kamra magħluqa għall-ħami, it-tisjir jew it-tisħin

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħobż fil-forn kien jinxtamm fit-triq kollha.
usage_examples.en: The bread in the oven could be smelt all down the street.

usage_examples.mt: Poġġejt il-laħam fil-forn għal siegħa sħaħ.
usage_examples.en: I put the meat in the oven for a whole hour.

definitions.text_mt: Isir vojt, jitlef il-kontenut
Jirtira, speċjalment l-ilma tal-baħar li jitbiegħed mill-art

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġibjun forogħ kompletament wara x-xhur niexfa.
usage_examples.en: The reservoir emptied completely after the dry months.

usage_examples.mt: Il-baħar jifrogħ 'il bogħod mix-xtajta fil-marea baxxa.
usage_examples.en: The sea recedes far from the shore at low tide.

definitions.text_mt: B'possibbiltà, jista' jkun li, għalkemm mhux żgur

usage_examples.mt: Forsi għada nżurkom jekk ikolli l-ħin.
usage_examples.en: Perhaps I will visit you tomorrow if I have time.

usage_examples.mt: Forsi jiena żbaljat, imma naħseb li din it-triq hija l-iqsar waħda.
usage_examples.en: Maybe I am wrong, but I think this road is the shortest one.

definitions.text_mt: Li jiġri b'kumbinazzjoni, mhux ippjanat jew mistenni

usage_examples.mt: Il-laqgħa tagħna kienet fortuwita, ma konniex ippjanajnieha.
usage_examples.en: Our meeting was fortuitous; we had not planned it.

usage_examples.mt: L-iskoperta fortuwita tal-fdalijiet bidlet kollox.
usage_examples.en: The fortuitous discovery of the remains changed everything.

definitions.text_mt: Ġrajja li sseħħ b'kumbinazzjoni, mingħajr ma tkun ippjanata

usage_examples.mt: Kien b'fortuwità li ltqajna wara tant snin.
usage_examples.en: It was by fortuity that we met after so many years.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fortuwità tal-avveniment ħallietna mistagħġbin.
usage_examples.en: The fortuity of the event left us amazed.

definitions.text_mt: Frotta żgħira u ħadra, ġewż li jittiekel tal-pistaċċi

usage_examples.mt: Konna nisimgħu li l-fosdoq kien jitkabbar fil-Lvant Nofsani.
usage_examples.en: We used to hear that the pistachio was cultivated in the Middle East.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fosdoq kien meqjus bħala frotta ta' lussu fi żminijietna.
usage_examples.en: The pistachio was considered a luxury fruit in our times.

definitions.text_mt: Qoxra ta' barra ta' xi frotta jew żerriegħa
Il-qoxra tal-ħarir li tagħmel id-dudu tal-ħarir madwaru

usage_examples.mt: Il-fosdqa tal-piżell kienet iebsa wisq biex tinfetaħ.
usage_examples.en: The pod of the pea was too hard to open.

usage_examples.mt: Id-dud tal-ħarir kien iħalli l-fosdqa tiegħu fuq il-fergħa.
usage_examples.en: The silkworm would leave its cocoon on the branch.
